note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 25 May 1905; two councillors for each division. Two new divisions, Aghory and Glenanne, were created by dividing Richhill and Markethill (Armagh Guardian, 2 June 1905, p. 5). Labels: the nomination list states that all candidates are Unionists save those marked N. Polled 25 May 1905. A new division, formed by dividing Richhill. The nomination list prints "James Creggan, Ballinteggart; John Troughton, Mullalelish; John Bleakley, Aghorey".
